pages.text: The Celestigem Bow surpasses $(l:tool_blazegold_bow)Blazegold Bow$(/l), utilizing Forge Energy instead of durability. It can hold up to 10,000 FE, ideal for long use without wear.$(br2)This bow features 3 'Potion Canister slots', allowing for customized effects. Load it with a $(l:item_potion_canister)Potion Canisters$(/l) for enhanced arrows.
